# 3c HOA Management

> Professional HOA management company based in Utah providing community association management, accounting, owner representation, and insurance claims assistance.

3c HOA Management Co. was founded by Carissa Cutler, who brings 20+ years of real estate experience and 10+ years of HOA management expertise. The company's philosophy is built around three pillars: Community, Care, and Connect — transparent, proactive management that keeps boards informed and homeowners engaged.

## Services

- **Property Management** — Board and homeowner meetings, vendor and contract management, insurance and compliance oversight, routine and preventative maintenance coordination, homeowner communications.
- **Accounting** — Annual budget preparation, accounts payable/receivable, assessment collection, bank reconciliation, financial reporting, Owner's Portal document storage.
- **Owner's Representative** — Capital reserve project management, stakeholder coordination, fund oversight, contractor scheduling, reserve study support.
- **Insurance Claims Assistance** — Claims filing guidance, adjuster coordination, repair vendor oversight, resolution tracking.
